utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Klar, ich kann um 7 Uhr fahren. Soll ich dich abholen?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ja, bitte. Danke dir.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Klar, ich hole dich um 7 ab.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can probably do it, but I need to know the pickup time and who else is in the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the pickup time and exactly who’s riding?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, but I need the pickup time and the exact list of riders first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the carpool. I might’ve missed a change—what’s the plan now?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it’s still the same pickup list, just shifted a bit — I’m trying to remember who goes first, but I can check it with you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, let’s check it together so I don’t miss the order again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can handle the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks. I’ll check in with you about pickup times later.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, just let me know the pickup time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — do you still need me in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I still need you. Can you head over now?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m on my way now.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: what time are you thinking for the carpool? I like having a set plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: How about 8:15? I can send out a quick heads-up and we’ll all leave together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 8:15 works for me. A quick heads-up is fine, and I’ll be ready then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I plan on for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d plan on about 15 minutes early, just to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, I’ll plan on being there 15 minutes early.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: How about 8:00? That gives me enough time to get everyone to the pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: 8:00 works for me. I’ll be ready at the pickup spot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can help with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thank you. I’ll get the schedule set up and send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, I’ll watch for the details and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep a list if you want, but I need Bo to tell me who’s riding when.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I’ll send you the ride times I know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, send them over and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool might need one more driver this week.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help if you need it. I might be able to take a shift if that works.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That would be great. I’ll let them know you can take a shift if they still need someone.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Faye, can you remind me what time the carpool needs to leave?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We need to leave by 8:10 so we can get there on time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, we should leave by 8:10.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can take the carpool. Just send me the time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll send you the time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, I’ll wait for it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep the carpool plan moving and I’ll tell the others too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks. I’ll let everyone know too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll keep everyone in the loop too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the carpool. Did something change?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I need to change the pickup for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can still do that. Just tell me the new pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can take one of the kids. Just tell me the time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll tell you the time as soon as I know it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, just let me know once you have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Opal. I’ll keep the carpool list updated and make sure everyone knows the pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll note the pickup times too, just so I have them straight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That helps, thanks. I’ll send out the updated times so we’re all aligned.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We should double-check the pickup times and who’s bringing everyone back so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll confirm the pickup and return times with everyone so nothing slips through.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, I’ll keep an eye on the return plan too so we don’t leave anyone stranded.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the carpool is still on for tomorrow, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, as far as I know it is. I’ll double-check the details and let you know if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just let me know as soon as you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. Let’s keep the carpool plan simple and stick to the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good to me, I’ll stick to that time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, we’ll keep it at the usual time then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I can hop in if you want me to check with everyone about the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll check in and let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sorry, Mara, I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I can help figure out the carpool if you remind me what we settled on.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Oren. We agreed to split the driving, and I can send you the exact pickup times if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, that helps. Send me the pickup times and I’ll take my share of the driving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can help with that. What time works best for pickup?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Pick me up at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Okay, I’ll pick you up at 7:30.
